content.short: Drips is a decentralized toolkit for recurring payments and social financing built on the Ethereum network.
content.description: Drips is an innovative decentralized protocol that enables users to manage recurring digital asset transfers and social financing strategies with ease. Built on Ethereum, Drips allows creators, developers, and organizations to set up automated payment streams, subscriptions, and memberships without relying on centralized intermediaries. The platform features a modular toolkit that integrates seamlessly into existing dApps, providing essential infrastructure for the emerging subscription economy in Web3. By leveraging smart contracts to ensure transparency and security, Drips empowers the community to build sustainable funding models and long-term financial relationships within the decentralized landscape.
content.meta: Drips provides a decentralized toolkit for recurring payments and social financing on Ethereum, enabling automated asset streaming for Web3.
